rule: 99.9th percentile of the cross-validated training DI distribution (feature-space envelope). A cell is inside the AOA iff no more dissimilar from the training data than all but 0.1% of training points. NOT a skill limit: OOF AUC-ROC stayed 0.97-1.00 with no decay across the whole sampled DI range.
note: Threshold set to the training feature-space envelope (p99.9 of CV training DI), not a skill boundary: OOF ranking skill (AUC-ROC) does not decay within the sample. Skill is measurable only over the DI range the biased training sample spans (to ~0.25); the envelope threshold sits just past that. Beyond it the AOA flags, this calibration cannot score.
